title: Norite voice data channel
description: Source of truth for every message on a voice connection's data channel (docs/architecture.md §6, ADR 0023, M26). A connection has exactly one data channel, labelled norite-voice, and every message on it is one UTF-8 JSON text of at most 8192 bytes. backend/voiceproto is its Go form, and the SFU's tests validate every message both ends send against this document. The client speaks first, with hello; anything else first closes the connection. Decoding is strict, so a field added to a message is a MINOR change. Who a source id is lives here; which packets are theirs is the CSRC each forwarded RTP packet carries, because this channel and the media are not ordered against each other.

ClientMessage.description: What the client sends: hello first, then subscribe as often as its preferences change, within the rate bound.

ServerMessage.description: What the SFU sends: ready in answer to an accepted hello, then the slot map and who is speaking whenever either changes; refused, last, before it closes the connection.

Snowflake.description: An id, as a quoted decimal string (ADR 0003).

Kind.description: A track's kind. Video is admitted from M105.

Hello.description: The client's first message: its version, which the SFU checks by the gateway's rule (ADR 0033). A mismatch is answered with refused, naming which side to upgrade.

Ready.description: An accepted hello's answer: the SFU's version, and which of the offer's receiving sections is which slot.

SlotIdent.description: One receiving slot: its index among the connection's slots of its kind, and the mid of the offer section it is.

Slots.description: The whole slot map, sent whenever it changes. A slot not listed is empty.

SlotEntry.description: One occupied slot and who fills it. source is the CSRC on every packet forwarded from that sender's track, unique in the room.

Speaking.description: Who is speaking now, sent whenever it changes: the RFC 6464 level, believed only while packets flow and only within the sender's rate bound. Never names a user the server excludes for this receiver.

Subscribe.description: Replaces the connection's subscription whole. pin is served first, in order; drop is never served; cap, when present, uses that many of the connection's slots at most. The server's exclusion applies before any of it, and a pin does not override it.

Refused.description: The SFU's last message before it closes the connection, in words a person can act on.
